R1.reason: Scrollbar thumb hover inside the shared `thinScrollbar` mixin. Custom scrollbars do not exist on touch devices, so the rule can never fire there and wrapping it would add a media-query nesting level to all 16 consumption sites for no behavioural change. The runtime probe honours the same allowlist.

R4.reason: Full-viewport transparent scrim. It holds no content and is not tappable chrome, so a home-indicator inset would do nothing — padding on a backdrop cannot move anything.

Vertically centred edge tab (top: 50% + translateY(-50%)), anchored to the viewport's right edge, not its bottom. R4 keys on any inset property; here `top` is a centring anchor, so the bottom inset is irrelevant. Left/right insets are also not needed: the tab deliberately sits flush to the edge as an affordance.
Mirror of ChatEdgeTab on the left edge — same rationale.
